external_sources.read_scope: Version page; PDF initial returned lines0–241, Section2 i.i.d./set-selection definition; find Theorem1/exchangeability; targeted open around285 returned268–336. No fulltext archive.
external_sources.paraphrase: Section2 assumes independent identically distributed observations. The expected false-selection-count bound additionally requires exchangeable noise selections and a selector no worse than random guessing. Selection probabilities can describe related variable sets. The theorem is not an arbitrary dependent-data FDR or predictive-utility guarantee.

external_sources.paraphrase: CPSS uses complementary half-samples under an i.i.d. data framework. Its general low-selection-probability bound avoids exchangeability and selector-quality assumptions; stronger bounds add shape restrictions. This does not transfer the result automatically to whole-user bootstrapping or two-date perturbations.
